monitoring_active.note: Health checks: Fly.io internal (30s interval) + UptimeRobot external (5min). REST API /health: database, ChromaDB, services. WebSocket /health: simple status. Alerts via email. Structured logging to logs/civic.json.log. See docs/critical/UPTIME_MONITORING.md.

backup_scheduled.note: GitHub Actions workflow runs daily at 2 AM UTC. Backs up civic_participation.db (user data) from /app/user-data/. Retention: 7 daily + 4 weekly. First successful run: 2025-12-16T03:44:32Z. See docs/critical/DAILY_BACKUP_SCHEDULE.md.
